question: Is the oncofetal cell-surface/secreted protein DLK1 a previously unestablished, reproducible EMC expression phenotype in authentic tissue and models, with enough specificity and biological value to justify further measurement?
rationale_to_verify_before_values: EMC's previously described neuronal/neuroendocrine differentiation makes an oncofetal neuroendocrine-associated protein a biologically motivated candidate. Verify this premise, DLK1 biology and original EMC prior art from primary sources before data analysis; this contract does not assert either premise or an EMC finding.
novelty_gate: Check original EMC expression studies, supplements, protein studies and model papers for DLK1/FA1/preadipocyte factor1 before examining our expression values. If the proposed finding is already established or the biology/usefulness premise fails, stop and report the primary evidence. Do not replace a failed gene with another target to keep the lane busy.
proposed_added_knowledge: A reproducible, previously unestablished measured EMC expression phenotype could motivate a specific protein/localization experiment. Gene-level RNA cannot establish membrane isoform, accessible surface protein, dependency, clinical efficacy, safety or therapeutic window.
analysis_gate: If prior art leaves the question worthwhile, record the exact tissue contrasts, sample identities, all eligible EMC conditions, held-out-assay allocation, uncertainty and operational thresholds before new values. Reuse existing frozen specimen metadata and source data. Include GSE4303 if its measurements are suitable; do not leave eligible accessible EMC observations unevaluated to advance the claim. Distinguish overlap/technical replication from independent donors.
contrary_evidence: Prior publication of the same EMC finding; inconsistent tumor expression or failed held-out comparisons; expression explained by stromal or normal-tissue composition; uncertain isoform/protein localization; incompatible or discordant authentic-model observations. A technically correct expression difference alone does not establish sufficient scientific value.
stop: One gene, bounded primary-source feasibility check and, only if justified, a prospective pilot. Independently challenge usefulness and omissions before any paper decision. Preserve all failures and amendments. No revival of TMEM266, TSC2 or other shelved papers.
ownership: Existing reserved genomics worktree, new round3/dlk1/ only. All earlier genomic, trial and imaging packets are frozen and integrated.
restrictions: Reuse installed dependencies and scoped sources. Measure free space before downloads; leave10GiB. Daily America/New_York06:00-10:00 prohibition on UI/browser/headless/screenshots; check actual time before each operation, September12 exception expired, avoid intensive build/render then. No paid resources, outreach, publication/submission, external scientific records, PR, commit or push. Full relevant public EMC coverage and automatic scientific follow-through duties persist.
